name: The Nightmare Forms
summary: Tamsin Ledger's dream self has set up a desk at the wedding and will file the party's complaints, if they are in the proper form.

stages.journal: Tamsin Ledger, in a dream, offered to file our complaints on the proper forms.
stages.hint: File at least two complaints with Tamsin at the wedding.

stages.journal: Some of our complaints are filed.
stages.hint: File one more complaint, then submit the forms to Tamsin for a stamp.

stages.journal: Tamsin stamped our forms. The stamp smelled of wedding cake.
Tamsin refused our forms: perjury in a dream is still perjury.
